notes.title: The First Update
notes.notes:
New Game - We have a Prelude now!

Load Game - You will always spawn at the World.
Load Game - You can clone and rename your save file.
Load Game - You start with full health instead of the previously saved HP.

Battle Results - J and K shortcuts for scrolling.

Hiragana Lessons - Made a new scene... mostly because I'm uncomfortable with the current one.
Hiragana Lessons - Digraph and Small tsu lessons

Katakana Lessons - Now starring Jason with his messy room and Piper at the coffee shop. They're gonna be part of the story.
Katakana Lessons - Digraph and Small tsu lessons

World Screen - Has keyboard shortcuts for Home, School, and Lessons.
World Screen - Has a Story mode. The prelude and episode 1 are available here. Haven't written the whole story yet though and Episode 1 has only started.

Home - Has a study mode! You can choose to heal w/ Study or Sleep.

Port - Took away the Loading Bay. I liked developing it but it's so boring to actually play.

Raceway - If you type "Katakana", you can type the Katakana version of Iroha.

Office - Now has a snake game.

Twitch Setting - Has a button to point you to the tmi url.

I'm not testing rebirths b/c mostly focusing on the first playthrough, but I've balanced it as follows.

Rebirth 1 - You now start with 2 HP as soon as you rebirth.
Rebirth 2 - Full Furi
Rebirth 3 - No Visual Feedback on cards
Rebirth 5 - Cards hit twice as hard
Rebirth 7 - Backspace hurts. (completely untested, will probably break the game)
Rebirth 9 - Kanji (completely untested, will probably break the game)
